tasks.short: Write and share research articles and reports

steps.what: Choose research findings, audience and argument
Assemble research tables, sources and citation metadata
Write articles or reports from selected findings

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory research prose from the author's argument
loop.input: argument, fixed tables and checked source passages
loop.check: Psychologist checks claims, numbers, caveats and every citation
loop.stop: One revision then manual rewrite of unsupported sections
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations and transitions require prose beyond a fixed report layout

steps.what: Check scientific meaning, disclosure and final article text
Format article references, headings and supplied tables
Submit final reports or articles to intended recipients

tasks.design: Configure source links, styles and reference fields in {DOCS}; draft explanatory prose only from the author's own findings and checked evidence. Formatting has its own machine step, and the final external {EMAIL} submission has a human check of the actual package.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writers repeatedly assemble evidence, prose and publication formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference fields and a bounded drafting loop can reduce this assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a sound argument and explaining uncertainty without overstating the findings.
tasks.human_edge: Scientific accountability and understanding the audience.

ambition.what: Test a separate plain-language version for workplace readers after the scientific text is checked.

tasks.altitude: From repeated prose and format work toward clearer research communication.

reach.learn: Keep each public claim traceable to evidence

evidence.claim: The digest reports a government report containing apparent AI-generated errors and fabricated references; this supports retaining source checks, not a saving estimate.
Native formatting and source-bound drafting savings are unmeasured design hypotheses.

assumptions: Baseline includes writing, formatting and actual submission; conducting the underlying study is not charged again.

The psychologist produces source identifier, passage, table version, units and permitted disclosure in s2, and records the required publication style there. Capture time is included. Missing identifiers or incompatible table fields are formatted manually.
Try native styles, citation fields and table links before a prose loop; no invented references or changed results.
Ordinary author saves in the same system are retained within writing and checking, with no self-gate or save saving.
The additional audience version is optional and uncounted in these savings.
unknowns: How much current writing can reuse checked findings
research_questions: Can authors produce equally accurate text faster when every drafted claim links to a supplied passage?

incremental.description: Maintain style mappings and inspect recurring draft failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact formatted article, references, tables, recipient and submission message; any change requires renewed final-package check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R68.5 gross31.5 less4 upkeep gives central27.5. Low retains19/20 source assembly,32/35 drafting and7/10 formatting because citation metadata are incomplete and the argument needs rewriting: gross7 less4=3. High retains17/20 assembly,24/35 drafting and2/10 formatting with compatible reference fields and reusable exposition: gross22 less4=18. Argument, scientific checking and submission remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Set psychological science topics and relevance criteria
Search literature and capture source metadata
Review titles and abstracts for reading priority
Read studies and assess psychological science implications
Record reading notes and source-linked qualifications

tasks.design: Configure saved searches, reference import and a reading-note layout in {DOCS}. Keep actual study reading and appraisal human; native bibliographic fields support the reading list and notes without generating scientific conclusions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searches and source metadata are repeatedly entered and reading notes lack reusable structure.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved queries and native reference metadata can reduce mechanical literature handling.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing study quality and recognising when a new finding should change professional understanding.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time organising literature and more time reading it critically.

reach.learn: Retain the context behind an apparent finding

evidence.claim: The digest identifies ASReview as a literature-screening product; its existence does not establish time saved in informal professional reading.
This design starts with saved searches and native references, with unmeasured local time estimates.

assumptions: The baseline includes existing personal notes where taken; it does not add a formal review report or publication.

The psychologist produces topics and search terms in s1, and captures title, author, date, source identifier, access location and relevance in s2-s3; s5 captures personal conclusions and qualifications. Capture remains priced, with manual lookup for missing metadata.
Native search alerts, filters and citation import come first. No model summarises unread studies or decides relevance autonomously.
Author saves of notes are fully retained within s5, ungated and not counted as a saving.
unknowns: Existing saved searches and reference imports
Whether personal reading notes are already structured
Coverage and metadata quality of subscribed sources
research_questions: Does configured search and reference import reduce handling while preserving the studies selected for full reading?

incremental.description: Refresh search terms and repair reference imports

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R85.75 gross14.25 less2 upkeep gives central12.25. Low retains24/25 search,14/15 screening and all15 notes because database metadata import poorly: gross2 less2=0. High retains20/25 search,13/15 screening and12/15 notes when saved queries and reference fields work: gross10 less2=8. Topic choice and critical full-text reading remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel workers on job and career issues

steps.what: Retrieve worker context and relevant career resources
Counsel workers and explore career-related choices
Write counselling notes and agreed career follow-up
Share agreed career follow-up with the worker

tasks.design: Configure a minimal counselling-note layout and linked career resources in {DOCS}. Counselling remains personal; the actual record is written separately and the final worker follow-up is checked before its {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Context and resource links are located again and existing follow-up notes are entered without reusable headings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and note structures can remove a small amount of record handling.
tasks.still_hard: Listening to the worker's concerns and helping them make their own choices.
tasks.human_edge: Trust, empathy and sensitivity to workplace power relationships.
tasks.altitude: Protect counselling time while simplifying the supporting record.

reach.learn: Record only what is needed for the agreed purpose

evidence.claim: Structured notes and linked resources may reduce record handling while the counselling conversation remains human.
The digest says psychologists remain accountable for AI-drafted notes; this design uses native note structures rather than ambient recording.

assumptions: Scenario includes the existing counselling record and an actual follow-up message; validate that these occur rather than creating extra paperwork to claim a benefit.

The psychologist produces the question and permitted context in s1, agreed actions in s2, and date, concern, relevant options and agreed follow-up in s3. Capture and confidentiality checks stay priced; unstructured sensitive details are written manually.
Use native note fields and resource links first; no recording, model counselling or automated career decision.
Worker is an internal employee in this scenario; an external client send would use external authority. Same-system note saves remain fully retained without an approval stage.
unknowns: Whether this practice already uses a structured counselling record
Permitted retention and separation from employer access
research_questions: Do native note headings reduce writing without increasing unnecessary personal detail?

incremental.description: Maintain career links and note fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact worker summary, destination and message; private counselling details must not enter the shared version, and any edit requires renewed check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R93 gross7 less1 upkeep gives central6. Low retains all10 context lookup and19/20 note writing when little content is reusable: gross1 less1=0. High retains9/10 lookup and17/20 notes with useful resource links and short action fields: gross4 less1=3. Counselling and the real follow-up send remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in mediation and dispute resolution

steps.what: Review dispute background and mediation arrangements
Participate in mediation and help clarify disputed issues
outputs: agreed next steps or unresolved issues

steps.what: Write mediation participation notes and agreed next steps
inputs: agreed next steps or unresolved issues

steps.what: Send permitted mediation next-step summary to participants

tasks.design: Configure scoped case links and short participation-note headings in {DOCS}. Mediation remains a human conversation; recording the actual next steps and sending the permitted version through {EMAIL} are separate steps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparation material and agreed actions are handled repeatedly without a compact structure.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and note headings can reduce small amounts of clerical handling.
tasks.still_hard: Neutrality, trust and navigating disagreement without imposing a resolution.
tasks.human_edge: Responsive listening and care with what each party has actually agreed.
tasks.altitude: Support mediation with a proportionate, accurate record.

reach.learn: Distinguish accounts, agreed facts and unresolved issues

evidence.claim: Native case links and short notes may reduce support work; mediation and agreement remain human.

assumptions: This scenario includes existing participation notes and an actual next-step message, not legal settlement drafting or signing powers the participant does not have.

The psychologist captures case identifier, date, permitted background and scope in s1; produces actions and unresolved matters in s2; writes owner, next step and permitted sharing scope in s3. Capture remains counted; uncertain agreement is recorded as unresolved and clarified manually.
Native case links and note fields come first. No autonomous mediator, ambient recording or inferred settlement.
Participants are internal colleagues here; a real external participant would change send authority. Same-system author saves are fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Whether notes and follow-up are part of this participant's actual work
Existing case view and note fields
research_questions: Can a short native note structure reduce transcription without turning disputed points into apparent agreement?

incremental.description: Maintain case links and note structure

approvals.approved_version: Exact permitted next-step summary and internal recipients; changes in wording or sharing scope require another final-version check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R94 gross6 less1 upkeep gives central5. Low retains all15 preparation and14/15 note writing because case materials need full reading: gross1 less1=0. High retains13/15 preparation and13/15 notes with direct case links and reusable action headings: gross4 less1=3. Mediation and the actual summary send stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce evidence and record assembly while protecting counselling, mediation and scientific judgement.
reach: More reliable source and case records
role.ambitious_version: A psychologist with more time for sound research interpretation and careful work with people.
